अरे यार! Saif Ali Khan पर हुए खतरनाक हमले का सच जानकर आपके भी रोंगटे खड़े हो जाएंगे! 😱

Koffee With Karan के लेटेस्ट episode में Saif और Kareena Kapoor ने उस डरावनी रात का जिक्र किया जब उनके मुंबई वाले घर में एक intruder ने हमला कर दिया था। 🔪

Kareena का कहना है कि वह months तक सो नहीं पाई थीं और Saif की पीठ में टूटे हुए चाकू का टुकड़ा फंसा था। रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, Kareena ने बताया कि वह रात को अपनी night T-shirt में सड़क पर चिल्लाते हुए autorickshaw रोक रही थीं जबकि Saif खून से लथपथ थे। 🛺

Show में यह भी खुलासा हुआ कि Taimur ने Saif से पूछा था, 'Abba, क्या आप मरने वाले हैं?' जबकि Jeh ने Saif को अपनी plastic sword देते हुए कहा कि अगली बार चोर आए तो इससे लड़ना। Saif ने बताया कि खराब चाकू होने की वजह से उनकी जान बच गई वरना एक millimeter और गहरा घाव जानलेवा हो सकता था। ⚔️

Online चल रही conspiracy theories पर Saif और Kareena ने जवाब दिया कि ड्राइवर शाम को घर चला जाता था इसलिए रात को घर पर नहीं था, और hospital Saif के बेटे Ibrahim ने Hari के साथ मिलकर पहुंचाया था। Karan Johar ने भी बताया कि उन्होंने Sara और Ibrahim से बात की थी और Bebo से तुरंत मिले थे। 🫂

क्या आपको लगता है कि सेलेब्स की पर्सनल लाइफ में ऐसी घटनाओं पर conspiracy theories बनाना सही है? नीचे comments में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Kareena Kapoor recalls ‘screaming on the road’ after Saif Ali Khan’s knife attack
ctx.text:
The early days of 2025 was one of the most terrifying periods for the Khan family as this was the time when Saif Ali Khan was attacked by an intruder at his Mumbai residence. The incident made headlines, with the actor narrowly escaping a potentially fatal assault. In the latest episode of Koffee With Karan, Saif and his wife, actor Kareena Kapoor, opened up about the traumatic night, revealing how Kareena struggled with sleepless nights for months and how their son Taimur feared his father was dying.
Karan Johar, who was among the first to reach out to the family after the attack, recalled speaking to Saif’s children,  Ibrahim Ali Khan and Sara Ali Khan, when the incident happened. “I had a chat with Ibrahim and Sara when the attack happened at home. And I remember what they were feeling because I reached out… and of course, I came and met Bebo immediately that day. I could tell that they were so shaken by the whole circumstance.”
Saif recalled how his family reacted when he woke up after surgery. “They were there when I woke up after my operation. And Ibrahim was very upset, and I don’t normally see him express himself in that way, but he was in tears and feeling very angry and wanting to defend and catch that fellow.”
Karan noted that Saif’s composed appearance when he left the hospital had sparked a different narrative online, with several conspiracy theories emerging about the attack. “You were so composed and elegant when you came out of hospital, that it spun a different narrative online. And then there was an array of conspiracy theories, which are born ridiculous.” Kareena responded by saying “bizarre” when Saif explained: “But I don’t expect people not to have conspiracy theories.”
Saif and Kareena also addressed several questions and conspiracy theories surrounding the incident, including why there was no driver at home that night. Saif explained, “Because he goes home to his family in the evening. So, there is no driver.”
When asked how Saif managed to get himself to the hospital, Kareena clarified, “He didn’t. His son took him to hospital with Hari.” Karan added, “Your nine-year-old son. And taking a bleeding father… I don’t know how…”
Kareena expressed disappointment over the bizarre theories that emerged in the aftermath of the attack. Saif then jokingly recalled how Kareena hailed an autorickshaw in the middle of the night. “In my night T-shirt. Luckily, no one got that on video, Karan. I was screaming on the road. I was like, ‘Ruko, ruko.’ It was like a movie scene. I didn’t have the time to put on my pyjamas. I have run on the road. Like nobody knows this. I am saying it for the first time.”
Kareena gestured to her thighs and said, “I was literally in my T-shirt that was till here. And running like a mad, crazy woman trying to get a rickshaw while he was bleeding.” Saif joked that Kareena was wearing an extremely short T-shirt and that it would have made quite a video. Kareena then recalled the moment she saw Saif in the lift.

“I looked at Saif in the lift and when I saw him, I was like: ‘Saif, don’t do this.’ And Tim just looked at him and said: ‘Abba, are you going to die?’ And I just looked at Saif, and he just gave me a look saying that ‘Take me to the hospital’.”
Saif said he knew he would be alright, but described the night as chaotic, with deep cuts on his neck and a piece of the broken knife lodged in his back. “That were quite deep and long. Like jagged cuts all over here.”
He added, “It was the worst knife in the history of knives. If it had been a slightly good knife, I would be dead. But it was such a bad knife that it broke.” Kareena revealed that if the knife had gone just one millimetre deeper, Saif could have died. Saif also said he had lost some sensation in his leg because the injury had affected his spine.
